old_caption: The video depicts a close-up scene where a person is using a knife to cut through a large, wrapped object. The object appears to be a ball or sphere covered in layers of red and green wrapping paper, which is tightly spiraled around it. The person's hands are visible, one holding the object steady while the other maneuvers the knife. The knife is being used to slice through the wrapping paper, revealing more of the object underneath. The background is plain white, emphasizing the action taking place. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the detailed process of cutting through the layers of wrapping paper. The lighting is bright, highlighting the vibrant colors of the wrapping paper and the texture of the material being cut.

caption: The video depicts a left hand gripping a roughly spherical ball of layered red and green material wrapped in glossy plastic against a plain white background. A knife at the right has its blade sunk into the side of the ball. As the action progresses, the blade is worked through the material, its profile shifting from a broad dark wedge to a thin edge-on line. The cut groove changes while the concentric layers separate around the blade, exposing the spiraling interior. The holding hand stays largely in place with small adjustments, and the loose top-right flap shifts slightly. Glossy highlights slide across the wrap as the geometry changes. The gray handle stays partly out of frame at the right border, and the slicing continues without a visible conclusion.
